records.governedTitle: Design and construction requirements for exit routes
records.codifiedHeading: § 1910.36 Design and construction requirements for exit routes.

results.sourcePhrase: Each exit route must be a permanent part of the workplace.

results.check: source supports: (b)(1) at least two routes
results.sourcePhrase: At least two exit routes must be available in a workplace
Each exit discharge must lead directly outside or to a street, walkway, refuge area, public way, or open space
without keys, tools, or special knowledge
Exit routes must support the maximum permitted occupant load
The ceiling of an exit route must be at least seven feet six inches

records.governedTitle: Electrical safety-related work practices - General requirements: protection of employees from contact with electric power circuits

results.check: source supports: (a)(1) proximity to energized circuits
results.sourcePhrase: No employer shall permit an employee to work in such proximity to any part of an electric power circuit
deenergizing the circuit and grounding it or by guarding it effectively by insulation or other means

records.governedTitle: Tools - Hand and Power, General requirements - Guarding: moving parts of equipment exposed to contact

results.check: source supports: (b)(2) transmission parts guarded when exposed
results.sourcePhrase: Belts, gears, shafts, pulleys, sprockets, spindles, drums, fly wheels, chains, or other reciprocating, rotating or moving parts of equipment shall be guarded if such parts are exposed to contact by employees or otherwise create a hazard.

results.check: source supports: (b)(1) tools designed for guards
results.sourcePhrase: When power operated tools are designed to accommodate guards, they shall be equipped with such guards when in use.
